messages:
jess: FYI customer reported Private VPC console shows 0 metrics for tenant 'acme-corp' since the ingress migration ~03:40 UTC. They can still call the API and get responses, but dashboard and /v1/metrics endpoints show no tenant data. Repro steps and headers below. @ryan can you take a look?

ryan: on it. do we have a request sample or proxy logs? first thought: tenant header might be getting stripped by the new ingress rule.

jess: sample curl from customer: 
```
curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-acme-..." \n     -H "X-Redwood-Tenant: t-acme-001" \n     https://private.acme.example.com/v1/generate
```
They sent the same request to the API and the model responded. But metrics pipeline logs show no tenant tagged.

metrics-bot: INGEST_LOG: 2025-11-01T03:42:12Z received /v1/generate from 10.4.12.8 auth: OK tenant: <missing> routing: private-vpc-ingress-2

maya: that log looks like header lost before the ingest collector. We recently flipped nginx ingress config to canonicalize headers (strip unknown headers). I pushed the change in ingress-migration PR #472. Could be related.

alex: Confirming — ingress change includes this snippet that may be the culprit: 
```
proxy_set_header X-Forwarded-For $proxy_add_x_forwarded_for;
proxy_pass http://private-ingest;
# intentionally drop all custom headers to prevent header spoofing
proxy_set_header X-Redwood-Tenant "";
```
I had added that to harden spoofing but forgot to map the tenant header into the internal request.

nora: Customer on thread says metrics needed for billing reconciliation and they're getting worried. Any temporary workaround we can offer while we fix?

ryan: quick workaround: we can enable tenant extraction from the JWT on the ingress auth layer (we already check the token to validate). I can roll a hotfix to populate X-Redwood-Tenant from the token claim `tenant_id` instead of relying on the forwarded header. That should restore metrics tagging for Private.

jess: can you also confirm there are no other downstream consumers that depend on the header being suppressed? We made that change due to header-spoofing concerns.

alex: double-checked: only internal logging and metrics need it. Security acceptable to populate header server-side from verified token after auth.

maya: repro notes from customer flow: 
1) request hits edge LB -> ingress auth -> internal proxy -> private-ingest collector -> metrics-db
2) after migration, internal proxy logs show header empty.
3) metrics-db has rows for requests but tenant_id=NULL.

jess: sample query from metrics-db: `SELECT count(1) FROM request_events WHERE tenant_id IS NULL AND service = 'private-ingest' AND ts > now() - interval '1 hour';` returns 14k rows.

metrics-bot: ALERT: metrics-tagging-failure threshold breached for private-vpc (14k untagged events).

ryan: I'll deploy the hotfix to ingress-auth to set `X-Redwood-Tenant` from JWT claim and flip the proxy_set_header back to preserving header where present. Doing a canary to 10% traffic first.

alex: recommend also adding an automated regression test in ingress-migration CI to ensure custom headers required by metrics are preserved or populated.

ryan: canary deployed at 04:05 UTC. monitoring for 15m.

metrics-bot: INGEST_LOG: 2025-11-01T04:07:38Z received /v1/generate from 10.4.12.9 auth: OK tenant: t-acme-001 routing: private-vpc-ingress-2

jess: customer confirms console started showing recent data at ~04:12 UTC (roughly 7m after deploy).

nora: spoke with customer, they accept the workaround but ask for root-cause writeup and ETA on a permanent fix.

maya: root cause: ingress hardening change accidentally nulled custom tenant header without replacing it with a safe server-side mapping. Permanent fix: update ingress migration docs + add CI test + deploy server-side tenant population. I'll draft the postmortem.

alex: created issue INF-1198 to add regression test and update runbook.

jess: resolution steps for support notes: 1) escalate to eng-infra (done) 2) deploy hotfix to ingress-auth to populate X-Redwood-Tenant from JWT 3) revert header-null behavior and add tests 4) notify customer and billing ops (they may need backfill).

metrics-bot: BACKFILL_JOB: scheduled backfill for tenant t-acme-001 spanning 03:40-04:10 UTC. estimated runtime 6m.

jess: thanks everyone. marking resolved for customer; will attach postmortem draft and follow up on backfill completion. :white_check_mark:

metrics-bot: BACKFILL_COMPLETE: tenant t-acme-001 records updated (2,432 rows) :shipit:

alex: follow-up TODOs: add test for header preservation, document secure server-side population pattern, validate other tenants.

nora: closing loop with customer and copying billing team. they thanked support for quick turnaround. :pray:
